about.intro_content: Prof. Yue Lv is Chief of the Department of Hematological Tumor at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, a position held since 2009. He specialises in chemotherapy and targeted therapy for oncology, with particular focus on hematological tumors difficult to diagnose and treat.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Lv's clinical and research interests include leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma and myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), as well as sarcoma. He has led studies on acute lymphoblastic leukemia treatment protocols, including the MRC UKALLXII/ECOG E2993 induction regimen and PEG-asparaginase use in Chinese patients, and has co-authored extensive research on extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma treatment and prognosis alongside SYSUCC's hematological oncology team. He completed his medical doctorate at Sapporo Medical University, Japan.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Yue Lv

items.question: Does Prof. Yue Lv accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to hematological tumors at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Lv's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Lv specialises in chemotherapy and targeted therapy for hematological tumors, including leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma and myelodysplastic syndrome.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Lv treat acute lymphoblastic leukemia?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Lv has led research on induction therapy protocols and PEG-asparaginase treatment for adults with acute lymphoblastic leukemia in China.

items.question: What department does Prof. Lv lead at SYSUCC?
items.answer: Prof. Lv has been Chief of the Department of Hematological Tumor at SYSUCC since 2009, having previously served in the Department of Medical Oncology from 2003.
